lede: We offer competitive and recreational level classes to children from the ages of 3 years old and up to high school. We follow the USA Junior Olympic Gymnastics program.
about: We offer competitive and recreational level classes to children from the ages of 3 years old and up to high school. We follow the USA Junior Olympic Gymnastics program. Our classes are led by our fully qualified and experienced teachers. Along with learning new skills, your child will learn the importance of discipline whilst having the opportunity to meet new friends and have fun. We have Russian speaking coaches.
Does your child want to learn how to tumble, flip and compete? Enroll them in our gymnastics program today.
